label: EXTENDED_HISTORICAL_RESEARCH
FROZEN_PRE_REGISTERED_TEST
purpose: Complete audit record: the pre-registration as it stood before any outcome was observed, the feasibility finding, the aborted runs, and the single authorised result. INFORMATIONAL ONLY - no trading logic reads this.

pre_registration.unfavourable_result_rule: No repair to R1/A1/B1. Retire or create a separately named version.
pre_registration.burn_rule: The OOS dataset is permanently burned once performance is inspected.

feasibility.note: Projection recorded before the run. Actual was 15. The marginal projected sample size was part of the pre-run audit trail.

aborted_runs.cause: HTTP 451 from api.binance.com; GitHub-hosted runners are geo-blocked. The frozen engines use data-api.binance.vision.
Bar-shape mismatch. signal.py reads 6-tuples carrying quote and taker volume; execute.py unpacks 4-tuples. ENGINE_ERROR on all 69 evaluations.

research_notes: R1 passed the pre-registered gross-profit concentration thresholds but failed a stronger descriptive robustness diagnostic: removal of its single best trade changed OOS return from positive to negative.

The pre-registered concentration criterion measured against gross profits (winners only). With 10 losses against 5 wins, the losses consume most of that gross profit, so a winner at 37% of gross profits was still the entire net result. This limitation is preserved, not corrected retrospectively.
PUMP contributed negatively across all three strategies in this window. Recorded descriptively. No coin-selection change authorised; optimising on the burned dataset is prohibited.

In-sample versus OOS divergence: R1 development +499.6% vs OOS +11.76% AMBIGUOUS; A1 +36.9% vs +11.14% PASS; B1 +37.1% vs +15.89% PASS. The development ranking inverted. Development and OOS returns must never be combined into a single validation metric.

burned_data_declaration.meaning: This period must never again be described as unseen or out-of-sample for any strategy version developed after these results became visible. For any future R2/A2/B2 or other post-dated strategy, it is known historical data.
